subject: R inla is not responding in R 4.3.2

messages.author: ab78e227e394cf1d
messages.subject: R inla is not responding in R 4.3.2
parts:
Hi INLA Members,

Good Morning!

Today after installing the latest version of INLA from the website and R version 4.3.2 from CRAN inla is not responding. Previously it was fine with R 4.3.1 but it seems they have removed that R version from CRAN website.

Can you suggest which versions of INLA and R should I install to work for now?

Thank you a lot in advance! Here I post my error message.

Alokesh manna

Department of Statistics

University of Connecticut, US
